title: Worktree submodule main-branch merge fixture
command: Disposable nested Git fixture: bootstrap a worktree, commit a nested submodule feature branch and superproject gitlink, then run `tools/worktree/worktree.sh merge <name>`
detail: Verifies the submodule main checkout is on main and equals the feature commit, and the superproject main gitlink equals that same commit. Also run bash -n and merge --dry-run.
